description: 12h memory-stability soak - Rust valkey-glide-rust, one cell. There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: GLIDE Rust is a path dependency on a valkey-glide checkout pinned by GLIDE_COMMIT in infra/provision.sh; change that default on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. Memory signal: engine process-group RSS sampled every 5s into <label>.system.ndjson. 64 connections = 64 OS threads (one per client at pipeline_depth 1) that mostly block on I/O, which loads GLIDE without oversubscribing the 8-vCPU m5.2xlarge shared with the colocated server. Launch with --runtime-cap 780 so the cap never fires before the upload; run soakctl-rust on its own instance in parallel as the control.
